Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run-chase! The West Indies players are out there in the middle. Sophia Dunkley and Danni Wyatt are the openers for England. Chinelle Henry to start with the ball. Here we go...
The Run Chase.....

England, on the other hand, would be satisfied with their bowling effort. Their pacers, Bell and Brunt got the new ball to swing but could not find breakthrough in the Powerplay. However, Glenn broke the opening stand just after the Powerplay and after that quality spinners like Ecclestone and Dean along with Glenn herself managed to keep the scoring rate under check. They got regular wickets too after the 10-over mark and Ecclestone finished with three wickets bowling brilliantly in the death. It is upto English batters now to chase this one down and if they bat to their potential, England should do it quite comfortably. Let's see how things pan out. Stay tuned for the run-chase!

Hayley Matthews, the Windies skipper decided to bat first after winning the toss and led from the front as West Indies got off to a brisk start courtesy of Matthews playing some fantastic shots. However, Taylor struggled at the other end failing to get bat on the ball and departed eventually on a score of just 3 off 15 balls. Shemaine Campbelle coming in at number 3 batted well after that but the big blow was the wicket of Matthews in the 11th over who played a good knock of 42 off 32 balls. The run-scoring slowed down after her wicket but West Indies somehow managed to get to 135 here with Campbelle scoring 34 and some handy little contributions from lower middle order.

A decent score on the board this by the Windies. They have managed to reach 135 here. Their highest total against England in the Women’s T20 World Cup history. However, the questions is, will this be enough against a strong English batting line-up? Probably not. It is a competitive total though and if West Indies bowl well, we surely are in for an interesting second half of this game.

Poor fielding and West Indies Women do get three runs to close out the innings. This is dug in short and well outside off, Chedean Nation reaches out and slaps it away toward deep point. The fielder there cuts it off but Shamilia Connell is already halfway through to the batter's end. The throw does come to the keeper but Nation is struggling to get to the other end. Amy Jones takes off her gloves but her throw is a high one and Nation makes her crease. West Indies Women finish with 135/7!
Another slower one outside off, Shamilia Connell advances and pushes it firmly to short cover. The fielder there misfields adn allows the single.
Three in a row, excellent bowling from Lauren Bell. Full and just inside the tramline outside off, slower as well. This time Shamilia Connell looks to go through covers but misses yet again.
And again! Another leg cutter, on a fullish length and outside off, yet another swing and a miss from Shamilia Connell.
A leg cutter now, full and outside off, going away from the right-hander. Shamilia Connell is completely undone as she looks to heave it across the line.
A full toss around off, dipping on the batter, Chedean Nation only manages to hit it down the ground for a single.
Shamilia Connell is the next batter in.

OUT! LBW! Yet another lbw and Sophie Ecclestone has her third wicket of the game. Ecclestone comes from over the wicket and bowls a loopy delivery, very full and on middle and leg. Zaida James gets down on one knee and looks for the slog-sweep but the ball is just too full for it. James misses and the ball hits her on the pads. England Women players appeal and the finger is raised.
Floated up full and outside off, Zaida James gets low and lofts it over mid off for a couple of runs.
Zaida James is the next batter in.

OUT! LBW! Excellent review in the end by Heather Knight. Sophie Ecclestone fires this one in fuller and around middle and leg, with the ball sliding on. Afy Fletcher gets her front leg out of the way and has a big heave across the line. Fletcher misses and gets pinged on the pads. There is a loud appeal which is turned down and on reviewing, Ball Tracking comes up with three reds. The on-field decision is overturned and Fletcher has to walk back.

Is Afy Fletcher LBW here? The umpire has given it NOT OUT but it looked dead straight in real time. The replays roll in and the UltraEdge shows no bat here. The Ball Tracking rolls and it shows three reds. So, the original decision is reversed. Afy Fletcher is gone!
Tossed up outside off, Afy Fletcher advances and forces the lofted shot over the cover region for a couple of runs.

Flighted, very full and around off, Chedean Nation drives it toward mid off and sets off for the single. There is s shy at the bowler's end from Alice Capsey but she misses and had that hit, Nation would have been a goner.

Beaten! Gives it a nice loop and bowls it full around off stump, Chedean Nation looks for the big heave but the ball turns away and beats the bat. Amy Jones takes off the bails and there's a stifled appeal for stumping. The decision is sent upstairs and UltraEdge is checked first. There's no bat involved and replays show that Nation has her back leg grounded inside the crease.
Leg bye! Floated up on the pads, Chedean Nation looks to sweep but misses and the ball just clips the pad before going past the keeper. The batters scamper through for a quick leg bye.
Short again but a lot straighter, Afy Fletcher pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
Quicker and shorter around off, this is dabbed down to short third man for a quick single.

Tossed up full and outside off, Afy Fletcher comes forward looking for the drive but edges it down toward third man. Lauren Bell from inside the ring chases it down and pulls it back in. Alice Capsey tidies up and the batters get three runs.
FOUR! Nicely done! This is looped up outside off, Afy Fletcher waits for it and reverse sweeps it fine of the fielder at short third man for a boundary.
Just short! A tad shorter and on leg stump, Chedean Nation shuffles across and padfdles it on the bounce to the fielder at short fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around off, this is punched away toward extra cover where the fielder makes a half-stop and they pick up a quick run.
Afy Fletcher walks out to the middle now.

OUT! RUN OUT! A moment of brilliance from England Women skipper Heather Knight and Chinelle Henry has to depart as well. Katherine Brunt bowls it slower and fuller around off, Henry pushes it gently toward the cover region and sets off for the single. Knight thre attacks the ball well and with just a half-turn throws it onto the stumps at the bowler's end. Henry does put in the dive but the replays show that she was well short.
Straight to the fielder! Short and wide, hammered away straight toward point.
Good length around off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Chedean Nation is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! A fine, fine catch by Amy Jones behind the stumps and Shemaine Campbelle has to walk back. Katherine Brunt bowls the off-cutter now, on a good length and around off. This one bounces a bit extra and takes the outside edge as Campbelle looks to cut close from the body. Jones who is standing up to the stumps takes a sharp catch to her right and Campbelle's fighting knock comes to an end.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Jones b Katherine Brunt

Commentary.Commentary: TWO WIDES! An attempted leg cutter but it is spilled down the leg side and Amy Jones is only able to get a glove on it. They pick up a single as well.
FOUR! Thrashhes and thrahses hard! This is short and wide, Chinelle Henry goes after it and slashes it over backward point for a boundary.
Katherine Brunt is back on. Two overs for 15 runs so far.

A wasteful review in the end. Sophie Ecclestone floats it up on the pads, looking to turn it away. Shemaine Campbelle sits down looking for the sweep but seems to have missed it. The ball hits Campbelle on the pads and there is a loud appeal for lbw but the umpire says no. England Women do review it and UltraEdge confirms that the ball did hit the gloves before crashing into the pads. The on-field decision stands.
TWO LEG BYES! This is fired in on the pads, Shemaine Campbelle looks to sweep but the ball comes off the pads and goes toward fine leg. The race back for two leg byes.
FOUR! A juicy full toss around off, Shemaine Campbelle just times it back past the bowler and to the left of mid on for a boundary.
Nicely flighted, on a shorter length and around off, Shemaine Campbelle comes forward but ends up just blocking it out.
WIDE! This is quicker and down the leg side again, Shemaine Campbelle misses the sweep and a wide is called. The 100 is now up for West Indies Women.
Floated up on the pads, Shemaine Campbelle paddles it away wide of the fielder at short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Beaten! This is slower and shorter, turning away a long way from around off. Shemaine Campbelle looks to pull but is through her shot way too early.
FOUR! Well played! This is very full and on the stumps, Chinelle Henry stays deep in her crease and drives it through the gap between covers and mid off for a boundary.
Pulls the length back a bit and bowls it on off stump, Henry defends it out.
Around off stump, knocked down to wide long on for one more.
Flatter and on off stump, this is cut away late and down to backward point.
Good shot but just for one. This is tossed up on middle, Chinelle Henry lofts it straight down the ground but Katherine Brunt runs quickly to her left from long on and prevents the boundary.
A low full toss on middle and leg, Shemaine Campbelle uses her feet and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Full and angling down leg, Shemaine Campbelle helps it 'round the corner for a single.
This is banged in short and over the stumps, Chinelle Henry pulls it well in front of deep mid-wicket for one.
Good length, around middle and angling in, Chinelle Henry looks to pull but gets a faint inside edge onto the back leg.
TWO WIDES! Full and spilled down the leg side, past the keeper toward short fine leg. They pick up a single as well.
EDGED AND FOUR! This is the back of the hand slower ball, on a length and on off. Shemaine Campbelle is drawn forward and gets an outside edge fine of the fielder at short third man for a boundary.
Goes full now and angles it into the off pole, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it back to the bowler.
Short of a length and around off, this is punched away toward cover for a single.
Flatter delivery around off, Chinelle Henry is quick to get on the back foot and cuts it straight to sweeper cover for a single.
A loopy full toss around off, Shemaine Campbelle steps out but mistimes the lofted shot down to long on for only a single.
This is flighted up on middle and leg, Shemaine Campbelle pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Slows it up now and bowls it on a nagging length outside off. Shemaine Campbelle looks to cut off the back foot but misses.
Quicker one on off stump, this is forced away to mid off for a quick single. Good running.
This is flatter and on off stump, Shemaine Campbelle backs away and cuts it in front of square on the off side for a run.
This is full and around off, Chinelle Henry defends it out on the off side.
Tossed up around middle, Shemaine Campbelle advances and chips it down over mid on for a single.
This is floated up outside off, really slow through the air and Campbelle keeps it out.

FOUR! Streaky but will do. Tossed up around the leg stump, Shemaine Campbelle goes for the reverse sweep but ends up getting a top edge over the keeper's head and the ball trickles away into the fence.
Flatter one, turning in sharply toward middle and leg, Chinelle Henry tucks it away leg side for a run.
Chinelle Henry walks out to the middle now.

OUT! RUN OUT! The hesitation in the middle has cost West Indies Women big time! Charlotte Dean serves it shorter and around middle, Shabika Gajnabi pulls it toward deep square leg. The batters complete the first run and think about the second but take a couple of extra seconds to go for it. Alice Capsey in the deep fires in a flat throw at the keeper's end and Amy Jones whips on the bails in a flash. The third umpire is called in and Gajnabi is short by a few inches. England Women coming back into the game very strongly here.
A wild slog to end the over! This is flighted on off stump and turning away, Shemaine Campbelle goes for the slog-sweep but misses it by a long way.
Slows it up now and floats it on a length around middle and off. Shemaine Campbelle blocks it out.
Short and outside off, tapped away in front of point for a single.
Gives it a nice loop and bowls it on off stump, dipping on the batter. Shabika Gajnabi manages to keep it out.
Shabika Gajnabi is the next batter in.

OUT! LBW! Sophie Ecclestone comes back into the attack and gets the big breakthrough for England Women. This is bowled flatter and around middle, just sliding on, Matthews looks to block off the front foot but misses and gets pinged in front. There is a big appeal for lbw and the finger is raised! This one looks to be pretty straight but Hayley Matthews does review it. The third umpire checks UltraEdge first and there's no bat involved. Ball Tracking comes up with three reds and Matthews has to depart. West Indies Women are out of reviews as well.
This is on the shorter side and wide of the off stump, Hayley Matthews rocks back and cuts it straight to point.

Drinks break! Right then, at the halfway mark of the first innings, West Indies Women are pretty much in control with the score being 69/1. Hayley Matthews has got off to a solid start and will be the key for them in order to set a formidable total. England Women have the bowling options with and and it is all about how Heather Knight manages their workload. A fascinating phase of play awaits. Sophie Ecclestone is back on.
Shorter and turning into leg. Shemaine Campbelle tucks it to short fine leg for a single.
On the shorter side and around off. Shemaine Campbelle cuts it to deep point for a couple.
Serves it full again and outside off. Matthews drives it to deep cover for a single this time.
Goes fuller and outside off. Shemaine Campbelle drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
WIDE! Wayward delivery! Short and way down the leg side. Shemaine Campbelle tries to pull it but misses.
Nice loopy delivery on off. Matthews waits for it and pushes it to point for a single.
Short and outside off. Matthews tries to cut it but misses.
Fraction short and on off. Shemaine Campbelle punches it to sweeper cover for a couple.
Short and a googly on middle. Hayley Matthews makes room to cut but somehow manages to hit it to mid on off the inside half for a single.
Tosses it up and outside off. Shemaine Campbelle drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter one and touch shorter. Shemaine Campbelle punches it to covers.
A flatter one on off. Matthews punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shortish and around off. Hayley Matthews cuts it to the backward point fielder.
Serves it fuller and angles it on middle. Shemaine Campbelle clips it to the mid-wicket fielder.
TWO BYES! Sciver bangs it short and on middle. Jones who is standing up to the stumps, fails to collect it. The ball goes off her gloves behind her and another two runs are added to the total.
A slower length delivery on leg. Shemaine Campbelle tucks it to fine leg and the batters take another two.
Shortish and on off. Shemaine Campbelle pulls it to deep square leg for a couple.
Goes fuller and on off. Shemaine Campbelle clips it to short mid-wicket.
Sciver starts with a length delivery on middle. Hayley Matthews clips it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Natalie Sciver comes on to bowl now.
Tossed up and on off. Shemaine Campbelle pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! This time she gets one away! Glenn with a flatter delivery on middle. Shemaine Campbelle sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Goes fuller and on middle. Shemaine Campbelle tries to reverse-sweep it but mistimes it to short third man.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Shemaine Campbelle fends it out.
Shemaine Campbelle is in at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Stafanie Taylor's misery comes to an end! This is her comeback game and it has been a while since she has played some quality competitive cricket and that really showed in her batting today. She just could not get bat on the ball. This one is short and turning into middle and leg. Not a delivery that should trouble any international quality batter but Taylor fails to connect her pull shot and gets hit on the pads. A big appeal follows and the umpire raises the finger. Stafanie Taylor takes a very late review but the replays confirm that he is out with Ball Tracking showing three reds on it and no bat involved as well.
Shortish and on off. Taylor tries to pull it but gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Sarah Glenn is brought into the attack now.

FOUR! This is high quality batting! At the end of the Powerplay, West Indies Women are 47 for 0! Touch short again and outside off. Matthews knew that third man is inside the circle and very cleverly guides it past short third man for a boundary.
A slower length delivery on off. Hayley Matthews tries to drive it but mistimes it.
On a length, on off. Hayley Matthews fends it off the front foot.

FOUR! WOW! What a shot this is! Not a bad delivery by any stretch of imagination. Just short of good length and around off. Matthews goes deep in her crease and opens her bat face at the last moment a bit as she punches it past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Hayley Matthews is dealing in boundaries here! Short and on off. Matthews pulls and pulls it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Shortish and outside off. Taylor guides it to third man for a single.
Katherine Brunt (1-0-2-0) is back on.
FOUR! Hayley Matthews is looking in great touch here! This is full and outside off. Matthews leans forward and drives it crisply through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Bowls it short and down the leg side. Hayley Matthews tries to pull it but misses.
Shortish and outside off. Matthews cuts it to backward point.
Flatter and quicker on off. Matthews tries to sweep it but misses. The ball hits her pads and there is an appeal but no damage done.
FOUR! Nice placement this time! This is short and outside off. Matthews cuts and cuts in the gap through the backward point region for a boundary.
Touch shorter and outside off. Taylor dabs it with soft hands towards short third man and a single is taken.
Shortish and outside off. Taylor cuts it to the backward point fielder.
Sophie Ecclestone comes into the attack now.
Touch short, quicker and on off. Matthews chops it towards the off side.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short and on off. Matthews goes deep in her crease and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Stafanie Taylor is off the mark finally! Short and outside off. Taylor steers it towards backward point for a single.
Tossed up and outside off. Taylor tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten again.
Shortish and turning into middle. Hayley Matthews works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller and on off. Matthews drives it to the cover fielder.
Again, Taylor plays and misses! Short of good length and outside off. Taylor tries to cut it but gets beaten on the inside edge as the ball shapes in nicely.
Serves it fuller and on middle. Hayley Matthews pushes it wide of mid on and takes a quick single.
On a length, on off. Hayley Matthews fends it off the front foot solidly.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Serves it bit fuller and outside off. Matthews leans forward and creams it delightfully through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Short and punished! First boundary of the game as well! This is short and outside off. Matthews cuts it hard past the point fielder for a boundary.
WIDE! Goes full and spills it down the leg side. Matthews tries to flick it but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Matthews punches it to cover-point this time.
WIDE! Short of good length and outside off. Hayley Matthews tries to cut it but misses.
WIDE! Full and way outside off. Hayley Matthews lets it go.
Beaten again! Serves it on a length and around off. Taylor pushes forward to defend it but gets beaten on the inside edge again.
On a length and outside off. Hayley Matthews guides it to third man for a single.
On a length, on middle and leg. Taylor tries to clip it but misses and the ball goes off her pads towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
On a length and outside off. It shapes away and Taylor gets beaten on the outside edge as she tries to push it.
Goes fuller and on off. Hayley Matthews drives it to mid off for a single.
On a length, on off. Hayley Matthews defends it from his crease.
Katherine Brunt to steam in from the other end.

Taylor has been given out LBW here! She has taken the DRS though! This is full and shapes sharply into Taylor. She tries to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. Bell appeals and the umpire raises the finger. However, Hayley Matthews immediately tells Taylor to review it and she does. The replays roll in and the Ball Tracking shows that the ball is missing stumps. The orginal decision will be reversed. It is NOT OUT!
WIDE! Goes fuller and it is down the leg side. Taylor tries to flick it but misses.
On a length, on off. Taylor fends it from her crease.

Good inward movement again and a big appeal for a caught behind from the bowler. No damage done though. Pitches it on a good length, outside off. It shapes into Taylor and she gets beaten on the inside edge.The keeper collects it and Bell is bit excited but no one else is including the umpire.
On a good length and outside off. Good shape again and Taylor who tries to punch it, gets beaten.
Goes fuller and on middle. Shaping in again and Hayley Matthews flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single to get off the mark.
Lands it on a length and gets it to shape into Matthews. She tucks it towards the leg side.
WIDE! Bell starts off with a fullish delivery that is bit too wide outside off. Hayley Matthews leaves it and the umpire calls it wide.

Done with the pre-game formalities and it is now time to get the play underway. The umpires are out in the middle as the England Women players are seen in a huddle before taking their places on the field. Hayley Matthews and Stafanie Taylor are the opening pair for West Indies Women. Lauren Bell has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. The teams take a knee as well to show their support against racism. Let's play...

We are a few minutes away from the start of play. But first, the two sets of players will line up for their respective national anthems. It will the national anthem of England first, followed by the West Indies' national anthem.

England Women (Playing XI) - Sophia Dunkley, Danni Wyatt, Alice Capsey, Natalie Sciver, Heather Knight (C), Amy Jones (WK), Sophie Ecclestone, Katherine Brunt, Charlotte Dean, Sarah Glenn, Lauren Bell.

West Indies Women (Playing XI) - Hayley Matthews (C), Rashada Williams (WK), Shemaine Campbelle, Stafanie Taylor, Shabika Gajnabi, Chinelle Henry, Chedean Nation, Zaida James, Afy Fletcher, Shamilia Connell, Shakera Selman.
TOSS - The coin goes up in the air and Hayley Matthews calls it right. West Indies Women have decided to BAT first.

West Indies Women, on the other hand, have not been at their best in recent times. However, they can can be pretty dangerous on their day. A lot will depend of how Hayley Matthews goes about her business but with Stafanie Taylor back in the mix there would be less pressure on Hayley to carry this team. Windies need a combined effort here to get past a strong English unit. Can they make a statement here with a win against England? Let’s find out. Toss and team news in a bit.
